description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Day-over-day coin bought and sold for each US spot Bitcoin, Ethereum and Litecoin ETF from official issuer holdings snapshots. Blank until two business days are saved. Filter asset=BTC|ETH|LTC or ticker. Returns JSON day-over-day coins bought and sold for each matching US spot crypto ETF.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

asset.description: Optional underlying asset. Format: BTC, ETH, or LTC, as the tool text states. Example: BTC. Omit for all three.

ticker.description: Optional comma-separated fund tickers. Format: uppercase tickers. Example: IBIT,ETHA,LTCC. Omit for every fund.

name: etf_flows
title: Day-over-day coin bought/sold by US crypto ETFs ($0.005)
